svg.title: IoTextra Octal3 overview
svg.desc: IoTextra Octal3 — Digital I/O with Latching Relay Module overview with key specs
svg.text: 4 isolated digital inputs · 4 latching DPDT relays · galvanic isolation · 3750 VRMS
Inputs up to 36 VDC via GPIO · relay contacts 250 VAC / 220 VDC / 2 A · relay control via I²C → TCA9534A → DRV8837C
Part of the IoTextra series · compatible with IoTsmart and IoTbase · Open Hardware
